name: Diagnostic set: blind test 1
description: 240 check-ins (160 emergencies, 80 everyday; 150 English and 18 each in Spanish, Chinese, Hindi, Arabic and Vietnamese) written and frozen by a separate Claude Code agent before it looked at the rules or the tests, then run once blind on 2026-10-19. The rules were then fixed by category using its misses, so it is NO LONGER BLIND: it is a diagnostic set, and blind test 2 is the honest number. Expected levels and checklist answers are that agent's reading of the ESI handbook. Its checklist answers were written before the 'ingestion' item existed. Nothing here was checked by clinicians or native speakers.

fields.max_esi: emergencies: shown at this level or more urgent
fields.min_esi: everyday: shown at ESI 3 or calmer (never 1 or 2)
fields.expected_esi: the level the blind evaluator expected
fields.truthful_flags: checklist ids a patient in that situation would honestly tap
